item.title: AI Coding Agent Harness Complexity vs. Cost Efficiency
item.description: A Shandong University and UC Berkeley study finds complex agent harnesses rarely beat minimal ones on SWE-bench accuracy while raising costs up to 3x.

item.title: Controlling LLM Operating Costs for Enterprise AI Agents
item.description: How enterprises measure repeated base inputs, accumulated context, and call counts separately while cutting exploration loops with ontology search and a Solution Cache.

item.title: How Uber Controls AI Coding Costs Across Models, Cache, and Tools
item.description: Uber kept total AI agent spend stable despite a 9.4x jump in weekly requests by breaking down cost drivers and tuning model routing, cache TTLs, and MCP tool loading.

item.title: Cutting Codex Token Costs with Multi-Model Agent Routing
item.description: Separate main Sol planning from GPT-5.6 Luna and DeepSeek V4 Flash subagents in Codex to reduce token spend without losing output quality.

item.title: Headroom: Open-Source Context Compression That Cuts Token Usage by Up to 95%
item.description: Built by a global streaming engineer, Headroom compresses agent context by 60-95% using local storage, structured summaries, and on-demand retrieval tools.

item.title: Cutting AI Coding Agent Costs in Half with claude-ns-hub
item.description: Open-source tool claude-ns-hub cuts autonomous coding token bills by 50% through context compression, decision memory, and tmux-based remote monitoring.
